executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM, general DRAM and HBM are currently among the tightest segments. The Daily Check from 2026-08-13 reviewed eight current relevant reports; there is no confirmed material change in direction at present. New capacity and improved yields could relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with delay. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
